Researchers propose that interactions between brain cells and their molecular surroundings could help explain the intimate connection between memory, emotion, and thought. Their findings challenge the assumption that increasingly powerful computers could eventually develop human-like consciousness.

items.title: After 11 Years, Kalyan Krishnamurthy Leaves Flipkart
items.summary: Flipkart CEO Kalyan Krishnamurthy is stepping down after more than 11 years with the e-commerce company. The Walmart-owned company did not disclose who would succeed Krishnamurthy or why he left. Balaji Thiagarajan, Flipkart's Chief Product and Technology Officer, and the company's board will lead the organisation in the interim.
